note: Jefferson County Conservation access on the Skunk River 5.5 mi north of Lockridge, on DNR land the county manages. Two areas: Riverside (20/30/50-amp) along the river road and Hillside (20/30-amp). Gravel pads with fire ring and picnic table; boat ramp, playground and shelter. Prone to flooding: call 641-472-4421 after high water. --Claude
summary: Rate changed $12 -> $15 electric ($10 without) from the county's own page (modified 2026-08-28). Confirmed 22 sites, 50-amp at Riverside, FCFS; added pit toilets, dump, drinking water, May-October season and the 14-in-21-day limit. Waterfront re-audit lead below.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (up, stored not waterfront): the county map puts the campground right on the Skunk River bank at the end of Macoon Rd. On imagery the Riverside road runs parallel to the river ~30 m from the bank; the river there is ~90 m wide (riverfront scale, not creekside). Between the road and the water is a strip of lawn under scattered trees, with open gaps reaching the bank along part of it (~41.0498-41.0503,-91.7346) and a denser tree belt to the north. Pads are not resolvable, so I cannot tell whether the Riverside pads sit on the river side of the road (open lawn apron within ~30 m -> riverfront) or the inland side (own road between -> riverview at best). The county's 'Campers with Kayaks' photo shows sites on open lawn under large trees, no river in frame. On this evidence at least riverview is supported; riverfront needs a per-site look (an on-site photo or a summer frame with rigs parked).
FEES: the county's own camping page (modified 2026-08-28) and park page say $15/$10; its mycountyparks page and the 2020 rules sheet still say $12/$9. Used the county's own current page.
SEASON: the county pages say 'Open May-October'; mycountyparks says 'Camping from April 15 to October 31st'. Recorded May 1-Oct 31 with both in season.note.

STATUS: no flood or closure notice on either county page read 2026-11-04; only the standing 'prone to flooding' warning. Pin OK (on the Riverside road). Website: the county's own page https://jeffersoncountyconservation.com/mac-coon-access/ could be added beside the mycountyparks link (apply.py writes no website). Phone 641-472-4421 confirmed.
